design: All five independent changes declared together before running their results; no feedback from a sibling or newer windows. Each before-fee signal is as-of previous close, execution Qlib weekly next open. No new money, shorts or borrowing. Starting capital USD 300000 per case.

hypotheses.v53: 多标的下行波动同步扩张时压低风险

criteria: Compare against v49 using v50 protocol on development, validation, main, stress and no_sndk. Also compare against parent v50 in every case. Historical cross-regime robustness requires 2 of 3 older eras with all three ratios and net return >= v49. Main annualized alpha must >=v49 and beta <= v49+0.08; average exposure >=90% v49 on normal windows. Candidates remain research only. If any pass use full-family simultaneous bootstrap before declaring evidence.
old_data: Newly acquired historical replay of today's chosen securities; SNDK absent. Not a prospective test; no fabricated SNDK predecessors or stitched adjustment levels. Older and recent accounts are separate.
statistics: 252 sessions, cash and risk-free zero, 20-session paired circular blocks, familywise max-t 95% intervals across 5 sibling policies and three ratios for each evaluation window. Outlier attribution, drawdown dates, historical scenarios. No promotion based on choosing the best retrospective row.
